title: The Lord's Prayer Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Lord’s Prayer Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Lord's Prayer Bible crossword: hallowed be thy name, daily bread, and deliverance from evil — the KJV words, clue by clue. Free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Most people who know one passage of the King James Version by heart know this one. The Lord's Prayer takes Matthew 6 line by line and asks you to put it back together — hallowed, kingdom, will, bread, debts, temptation, deliverance — with the KJV wording intact, debts and all.

It is a gentle puzzle and an unusually good one for memory: filling a word into a grid fixes it differently than reading does. The closing verse is where the prayer begins, which is a fitting place for the grid to end.
verseText: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
